title: Mold Remediation Work-Plan Lead-Time Hours Schedule
content:
Estimating schedule for the Mold Remediation work-plan visit when the plan must be written quickly. The work-plan lead time is the scheduled start date less the opened date in calendar days.

| Work-plan lead time | Hours added to the visit |
|---|---|
| At most 2 days (the rush plan days) | 0.5 (the rush plan hours) |
| Above 2 days and at most 5 days (the short plan days) | 0.25 (the short plan hours) |
| Above 5 days | None |

In words: a work-plan lead time of at most the rush plan days adds the rush plan hours; above the rush plan days and at most the short plan days adds the short plan hours; any longer work-plan lead time adds no lead-time hours.

Boundary cases on hypothetical dates, opened date 1 March:

- Scheduled start 3 March: lead time 2 days, adds 0.5 hours.
- Scheduled start 4 March: lead time 3 days, adds 0.25 hours.
- Scheduled start 6 March: lead time 5 days, adds 0.25 hours.
- Scheduled start 7 March: lead time 6 days, adds nothing.
